thunderstorm.title: Yellow Alert: Thunderstorm & Lightning
thunderstorm.instruction: Avoid taking shelter under isolated trees during lightning. Ensure drainage channels in seedling beds are clear.

agromet.generalMonsoonAdvice: Due to expected moderate showers, pause pesticide spraying and postpone fertilizer top-dressing until weather clears.
agromet.generalDrylandAdvice: Soil moisture is currently optimal. Maintain protective inter-cultivation for moisture conservation.

crops.soybeanAdvice: Ensure excess rainwater drains out from soybean fields within 24 hours to prevent root rot.
crops.sugarcaneAdvice: Carry out earthing up in sugarcane crops to prevent lodging from gusty winds.
crops.onionAdvice: Provide raised bed drainage for kharif onion nurseries to prevent damping-off disease.
crops.sugarcaneIrrigationAdvice: Apply light drip irrigation during early morning hours to maintain root zone aeration.
